entries: The next time you are in combat, try to call upon any absent companions. I believe the book will answer somehow.
下次战斗时，试着召唤缺席的同伴。我相信那本书会以某种方式回应。
Well... mostly. I still seem connected to that realm. I believe it was more than just the plant that caused the rift to open.
嗯……大体上是。我似乎仍与那个领域相连。我相信打开裂隙的不只是那株植物。
You did it! Whatever you did, this curse has ended.
你做到了！不管你是怎么做到的，诅咒已经终结了。
I believe the Codex was the catalyst, and I believe you could make it happen again.
我相信典籍，是那场变故的引子，我也相信你能让它再度发生。
